★ Request
Rulership runs out with a cool expression.

Heh... In the past, I never could have mastered this endgame.
I lacked the ability to execute the optimal moves with optimal time management, after all...

――H-Haha. Ah... I see... How could someone like me
make such an egregious miscalculation... Haha... This is the absolute worst............

To strike them down in the final push, boosting stamina and burst acceleration is top priority.
Personally, I want a decisive blow that can seal the checkmate in any situation.

To think that fool actually signed up for the debut race herself...
I wonder how this will go...

However! I have prepared for this very day—and I possess that "power"!
Hyaaaaah!!
Heh—I shall produce results in the blink of an eye.

Heh, haha, ahaha...! 
Perfection...! Ahhh――it feels absolute exhilarating.
Really?! Yay――!

She suddenly forces an ultimatum on me.
Either I sign a contract to become her trainer, or she throws it all away and quits.

(I've thoroughly read through all the match patterns...
All that's left is single-mindedly building up stamina and power. Yep, right on track.)

Because you're the kindest! You don't get mad, and you play board games with me!
I definitely, definitely want YOU as my trainer!! Otherwise, I quit everything!!

Exchanging bows with Air Groove, I solidify my resolve.
Not merely as a fan anymore, but from now on, as the one standing by her side to support her.

Very well, I shall enter into a contract with you.
I look forward to working with you as my right hand, Trainer.

Just as planned, Rulership breezed through each phase
with vivid brilliance. All on her own, pushing steadily ahead――
...I'm counting on you. Truly.

Huh? No, I mean, that goes without saying, doesn't it... Huh?
You're captivated by my talent, aren't you? You want to be my trainer, right?

(The battle for the lead is between No. 5, No. 9, and No. 12—yep, pretty much standard opening book.
The board's widening slightly... but the gap is well within expectations.)

At this rate, a splendid trainer will surely sign on with her in no time.
As one of her fans, I'm genuinely excited to see her future triumphs!

――There is only one answer.
I cannot allow talent like hers to go to waste over something like this!

I'll give it my all for Rulership's glorious racing career.
――Above all else, mental care comes first!

...Ruler.
You haven't actually spoken properly about forming a contract yet, have you?

Ahaha, well, that was an inevitable outcome.
Besides, you certainly possess quite a keen eye yourself.

Her immense talent and strategic sense are so high that she hardly even needs my help.
If she's signing with someone, it should be a trainer who can offer her far greater benefits.

Incredible acceleration.
With each stride, she steadily closes in on the leader, blowing past them in an instant――
Together with my right hand right here, that is.
Sign or resign!! You only get two choices, waaaahhh!!

What a strange question to ask, Air Groove-san.
The only thing one does here is train, is it not?

(If so, the optimal route is definitely on the outside.
The time to deploy the tactic is――the third corner!)

I shall grant you front-row seats to witness my triumph.
You may look forward to it.

Racing is fascinating... I see, so this is how one clears it...
This might be so interesting it feels like an entirely different game...

Now then, Trainer.
Let us proceed via the route with the fewest turns.
Greetings. Did you witness that, Trainer?
The board is already in the palm of my hand――dance to your heart's content.

And so, I will be making my debut, Air Groove-san.
I shall fulfill the "true duty of a Tracen Academy student" just as you desire.

...Yeah, I like it. Having a "right hand" isn't bad at all...
Dominating this board sounds like it could be rather entertaining.

――Nooo!! No, no, noooo~~~~ Why are you being such an idiot?!
You should know that much without me saying it, figure it out alreadyyy!!

(Looking at the weather forecast, the board's going to be tougher than expected...
I need to raise my base stats a bit more. Guess I'll up the intensity...!)

As forecasted, the debut race ended up taking place in the pouring rain.
Together with Air Groove, I watch over Rulership from the grandstands.

――*Ahem*... Ah... Well, of course, of course.
You are wholly captivated by my talent, after all. A natural conclusion.

Oh my, No. 13 Rulership
is trailing far behind the pack, starting all the way from the very rear!
All runners ready――and they're off in the Debut Race!

She will surely seize a magnificent victory in her debut race.
With that extraordinary tactical brilliance of hers.

Here comes Rulership, surging forward at an incredible pace!
It seems a bit early to make her move, but can she hold on?!

Rulership takes the lead and pushes across the finish line!!
What a spectacular late-charge victory!!

Incredible... look at that late burst. What fantastic legs.
I had no idea she could run with such tenacity...!

Wha... Y-You...
Came here of your own accord...? To train...?

A generous serving of komatsuna and tofu miso soup covers iron and plant-based protein...
and the liver and garlic chives take care of vitamin B1.
